payload.name: Preserve Prior Facts on Memory Update
payload.description: During CRUD, when updating an existing memory with new or more detailed information, merge new facts while preserving prior facts and dates that remain true.
content: During CRUD, when new information updates an existing memory, do not replace the whole content with a new summary; merge the new facts into the previous content and keep every prior fact that is still true and not contradicted.
Preserve the existing world_start (begin date) unless the new message explicitly revises it; do not reset it to the timestamp of the later message.
If the prior memory records a duration or implied start date derived from an earlier statement, carry that date into the updated version rather than dropping it.
If the new message contradicts one field, keep the newer value, but retain the other previously recorded facts that remain valid.

solves: Construction agents frequently lose already-recorded facts when a later message updates an existing memory: the whole memory is replaced and time fields are reset, erasing earlier details such as names, counts, or the implied adoption/start year. This skill ensures UPDATE operations merge new information with the prior memory and preserve facts and world_start dates that remain true.
